notes.title: notes for 1.1
notes.notes:
* equipment speed run glitch fixed
You can no longer go to the equipment room if there are enemies on the screen. Now you must eliminate the threats before changing your character's items. (Skulls still can only be changed in graveyards)

* q to hit in direction facing
If using the keyboard, press q to attack in the direction you last moved.

* new rooms to crystal caverns
I thought the crystal caverns were a bit short, so I added one room to the end.
